Container.Name: AspireUI
Container.Overview:
AspireUI is a self-hosted app platform and visual builder for container stacks. Install apps from a built-in store of 140+ apps, deploy any docker-compose repository straight from Git, and manage what runs: logs, env vars, ports, volumes, scheduled backups, notifications and your own domains (with Let's Encrypt HTTPS via Nginx Proxy Manager). It is also a visual editor for .NET Aspire AppHost projects - drag resources onto a canvas, generate real C# code, run it, or publish Docker Compose.
AspireUI drives the host Docker daemon, so the /var/run/docker.sock mapping is required for the Run and Hosting features. That is root-equivalent access to this server: keep the WebUI off the public internet and set an admin password on first start.
A first-run wizard creates the admin user. Set ASPIREUI_ADMIN_USERNAME / ASPIREUI_ADMIN_PASSWORD to skip the wizard.

Container.Requires: Access to the host Docker socket (/var/run/docker.sock).

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Required: lets AspireUI run and host container stacks on this server (root-equivalent access).

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Seeds the admin account on first start (skips the setup wizard).

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the seeded admin account. Leave empty to create the account in the browser instead.

Config.Name: Public host
Config.Description: Hostname or IP used in links to hosted apps, e.g. tower.local. Leave empty to use the browser host.
